title: Advanced nuclear fuel and demonstration policy
text: Advanced reactors, SMR demonstrations, HALEU fuel supply, licensing modernization, clean firm power and industrial heat are recurring policy priorities.

title: Nuclear expansion and advanced reactor program
text: Large PWR buildout continues alongside HTR-PM demonstration, fast reactor development and energy security framing.

title: Nuclear renaissance and EPR2 program
text: France announced construction of six EPR2 units and potential for additional reactors. Energy sovereignty and decarbonization are primary drivers.

title: Fast reactor and closed fuel cycle development
text: Fast reactor deployment, sodium-cooled technology, MOX fuel and closed fuel cycle strategy are emphasized.

title: Darlington SMR deployment BWRX-300
text: SMR deployment, BWRX-300 licensing, grid reliability and clean electricity targets are emphasized.

title: Hinkley Point C and future nuclear
text: Hinkley Point C EPR construction, SMR program evaluation, energy security and net zero targets.

title: First nuclear power plant program
text: Energy security, coal replacement, AP1000 technology selection, supply chain development and EU financing.

title: DAE long-term nuclear expansion program
text: Domestic PHWR fleet expansion, PFBR fast breeder reactor, Kudankulam expansion and thorium fuel cycle development.

title: CAREM SMR and nuclear expansion
text: CAREM small modular reactor development, domestic engineering capability and long nuclear experience are highlighted.

title: APR1400 technology export and domestic expansion
text: APR1400 export success (UAE), Shin Hanul expansion, SMR development (i-SMR) and hydrogen production.
